reviews.text:
Last visit the doctor miss diagnosed my cat. They dx her for UTI, it was not. The urine was too dilute after IVF. It was a guess by the doctor.
I brought my cat in with liquid stool and puking. They tried to discharge my poor cat while still stooling on my shirt. I refused to take my very sick cat home in the same condition we were trying to fix.  Also, the tech attempted to carry my cat in a carrier without the lid on it. I stopped him from doing so because my cat will jump from high areas and injure herself. I told them give her nausea medication and meds to slow her stool (probiotic treatment).
They did help my cat that is why this is not a one star, they gave fluids. But, wrong diagnosis and my cat took antibiotics for no reason. The antibiotics caused more vomiting and diarrhea at home. No treatment for my cat's nausea or diarrhea, until I told them to treat her for those issues. Lastly, safety issue with carrying cat in carrier without a lid.

Had to take my dog to Tell Tail Veterinary Urgent Care twice last week for a suspected foxtail as our primary vet was fully booked. So glad that we chose Tell Tail! We had a great experience (as much as it is possible at the vet). Everybody from the front desk to the vet techs to the doctors were super sweet and took great care of my baby even though he was very anxious about being at the vet. Great customer service and really caring staff. Highly recommend!

We had our first visit to this veterinary urgent care today with our pet, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. From the moment we arrived, the customer service was amazing. The entire staff was kind, communicative, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring.

We especially appreciated how thoughtfully the environment was designed. Both the waiting area and consultation room had such a calm, welcoming atmosphere that helped make what could have been a stressful experience much more comfortable for our pet.

Overall, we had a wonderful first visit and left feeling very confident in the care we received. If we ever have another urgent care need; or if someone asks us to recommend an urgent care for their furry loved one; this will absolutely be our go-to place. Highly recommend! 🐾
Was recommended this place and it did not disappoint! Everyone was super nice and helpful for my little guy Gordo and I and I’m super glad I went here. Highly recommend :)

They showed my fur baby so much care, were so helpful over the phone on multiple calls, and once I visited in person I was seen so quickly! Everyone on staff was so kind and caring with me and my dog. I feel so grateful for their help today taking care of him.

From the front desk and the vet tech to the doctor, everyone here was absolutely wonderful. Which I’m not surprised by since they have the same owners as Rancho San Carlos Vet, our primary. They saw us fast, they were very thorough, took time to answer all my questions, and the service was exceptional. Thank you to the whole team!

Side note: Marty could literally teach a master class in exceptional customer service. People show up in their most vulnerable moments and Marty could not be more kind, caring, empathetic. Truly wonderful dude.

We lost our beautiful Irish Wolfhound named Remus on 8/25. He was 4 months shy of 5-years-old. He was sloppy beard kisses. He gave the best head hugs. He was howls and bellowing barks and woofs. He was watchful and cared for our family especially our kids. They miss the way he sniffed the tops of their heads when they came home from school, as if he was counting them. He was kind to all creatures big and small, despite his impressive stature. He became a frequent OB Dog Beach goer that was beloved by all. He was MY everything. My hairy son. My loyal provider of hope and a being of peace.  He was and is irreplaceable.

On the morning of 8/25 we found Remus in the corner of our yard seizing and unresponsive. He had epilepsy but this was by far the wort we had ever seen. We estimated that he had been outside for 20 minutes. It was 78 degrees. Urgently and with great difficulty, my husband and I were able to get blankets underneath his 120 lbs of dead-weight to carry him across the yard, through the house, and into the car. My husband called Tell Tail Veterinary Urgent Care because it was close by and warned them of the severity of the situation and they sounded confident that they could handle it.

Two techs were waiting curbside with a gurney, which I appreciated and they did act with urgency. Remus was hauled into the back and they tried to save his life for 5 hours. He had a thready pulse and temperature of nearly 108.9.  Labs were drawn. He was given oxygen, IV cath, fluids, blood pressure monitoring, ECG monitoring, and dextrose. He also needed FFP (plasma infusion) which THEY DID NOT HAVE ON HAND and had to run and get from another veterinary facility, so this delayed his care tremendously. He was not neurologically intact and his prognosis was poor. We were able to go in and say our goodbyes as CPR was being performed and we told Dr. Brida to call it. On that table, he was no longer my dog and I couldn’t watch any longer. He ultimately died of heat stroke during status epilepticus and DIC. He went out in the worst and ugliest manner.

I do not not blame his loss of life on anyone. They did try, but the experience itself was utterly miserable.  I write this review is to warn others of our experience at Tell Tale.

We were told we could make a $5,000 payment that day because that’s what we could afford. This was misleading and not only are payment plans not accepted, but they will constantly berate you about funds the entire time your pet is dying. We paid the 5k with the help of family and they immediately came back in asking for more money. It gave the impression that it was all Dr. Brida cared about, unfortunately. Yes, I don’t think Dr. Brida and staff realize how thin the walls are. Through the door from our waiting room to the back where Remus was, I unfortunately heard Dr. Brida make the remark that “She’ll take the $5,000” because she needed it to pay off something for her car. I was instantly sick to my stomach and my husband angry at the comment, but we kept our mouths shut because I just wanted them to focus on my dog.

Additionally, Dr Brida was being coached by another doctor during the plasma infusion. I heard her saying that she had “never done this before” and the other doctor (presumably on a phone or another device) coached her through it. Time was ticking and I just feel that perhaps if we had taken him to an emergency vet opposed to urgent care, they would have been more experienced and been properly equipped to handle a situation of this capacity that required immediate intervention.

I do not recommend Tell Tail to anyone based on the way they pressure payment, lack of empathy from Dr. Brida, and lack of preparedness for an emergency situation. Now that we have Remus’ ashes, I’m happy that I never have to set foot into their facility. We will be keeping all future pets far, far away from Tell Tail Vet.
Abby, thanks for the 5 stars! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …

I was referred to Tell Tail when my vet couldn’t squeeze my cat in, and I am so thankful that they did! All of the employees at Tell Tail, from the front desk to the techs and the doctors, were all extremely kind and caring. We had to bring our cat in for urinary issues, and I felt that they had a great plan with diagnosing and treating our cat. They never pushed anything that felt unnecessary, and I felt that their prices were very reasonable for an urgent care. They go above and beyond by staying in touch and answering any questions that you have afterwards. I cannot thank them enough for their kindness and transparency, especially with a worried cat mom! Thank you Tell Tail!
Everyone is very kind and helpful, thank you for making a worrying situation easier!

We were in a dire situation 3 days ago ,our puppy took a fall & hit his head,we rushed over to Tell Tail.& Dr. SAURES immediately recognized the seriousness & rushed him immediately to an oxygen chamber where he could breathe more comfortably .
She could see we were frantic,she tried to calm us with her gentle way and didn't try to tell us everything was going to be alright.
Because they aren't open on weekends she arranged for our Reo to be transferred to VCA where he was treated for 2 days. We had to let him go the next morning, his little lungs weren't strong enough to clear, he wasn't able to breathe regular air so we tragically said good bye.
Jessica, Marty & Dr. Sauces were so kind and helped us through the toughest days of our lives. Thank you Tell Tail!
Sincerely, Liz Jardine & Michelle Natalier

We are on vacation from Palm Desert and our 3 year old golden retriever got a huge hot spot. My fault for not drying him properly, so needless to say, he ended up at Tell Tail Hospital.
The staff and doctor were absolutely wonderful. Miss Jessica the receptionist checked us in and reassured me he would be in good hands.  The lady doctor, I can’t remember her name, sorry, spent a lot of time explaining everything to me.
I wish I lived closer and she was in private practice. She would be my veterinarian.

If you need care for your pet, don’t hesitate to call them.

Thank you to all.
Christine Wood
Kind and professional
They do an excellent job! Our daughters kitty is treated with great care and love! Thank you!

My family and I are so grateful for the vets and staff here who saved my dogs life today. We had a very emergent situation and they took her straight away to be assessed and treated. I’m so so grateful!

Thank you everyone who had a hand in saving my dogs life today! I truly appreciate everything everyone does here. From  Marty being extremely kind and emotionally supportive, to Vince being so understanding and kind, to the team Dr. Brittany Withford leads, we were more than appreciative of our pups health care.

Thank you everyone! You’re wonderful ❤️
Absolutely phenomenal team that took such great care of my dog in his last days. Will always be grateful for their compassion.

Our experience was truly exceptional.

We initially came in because our dog had what seemed like relatively minor symptoms, including blood in her stool. During the visit, they gave her IV fluids and recommended additional testing for Addison’s disease. At first, I honestly thought the testing might be excessive, but I’m so grateful we followed the doctor’s recommendation.

The results confirmed that our dog has Addison’s disease. Without the doctor’s thoroughness and expertise, we may not have known what was happening until her condition became much more serious. Her judgment and advice were absolutely right, and we’re incredibly thankful that she took the time to look deeper.

The entire team was also very caring, compassionate, and professional. They made a stressful experience feel much easier and truly made us feel at home.

We’re very grateful for the care our dog received and would highly recommend this clinic.

This urgent care took great care of my pet. We were worried about toxicity and they got us in as soon as they could. Even though there was a bit of a wait, they were very up front with expectations and communication. Specifically want to shout out Marty at the front desk for being so friendly, patient and communicating well. Thank you!

Amazing office! Dr Halsey goes above and beyond! We were extremely nervous to have a mass taken off our min pin due to a heart condition so put it off way to long. Finally when it got to the point to where we knew it was bad contacted our normal vet rancho san carlos and they told us about telltails. We were extremely nervous but knew we had to do something. Showed up early to make sure that we could be seen and every one walking up for work greeted us. When we saw Dr Halsey she made us feel extremely confident that she was the vet to do this. When we picked up Valen it was after they closed and the staff was still smiling and having a good time even though we were keeping them late and the assistant came out and thoroughly went through the take home procedure. She was amazing throughout the entire process. Then Dr Halsey came out personally and talked to us about how the procedure went. I'm sure it was a long day by the way the office was full the entire time we were there and the fact that we recieved this type of service says the world.
Thank you telltails
Thank you Dr Halsey!

This place is amazing!

My pup had some wounds and they did amazing. I waited 2 hours (was told this already when I called ahead). They prioritize animals based on severity of the case, like a human ER.

I wrote down the names and lost them… but the 2 front desk people are AMAZING!!! The tech and veterinarian were also great! I explained that I just moved and was low on $$$ so she gave me a bulleted list to hand over to MEXIVET for cheaper care, and gave antibiotics for immediate care before seeing vet next day. They also have a payment plan that has 0% interest!!!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND
I spent the whole day there from 10 am to 7pm just for my kitten to get a seizure

brought my cat for an emergency.
and all i can say is that they saved my cats life and helped me out with the recovery by guiding me on where to go and what he would need in the future.
100% recomended

I cannot say enough good things about this vet. I brought my dog in yesterday,  she was having trouble breathing had a high heart rate. When I got there they immediately wanted to look at her. It's a good thing they did, she was in need of oxygen which they immediately put her on. They took excellent care of her and got her out of a really critical condition. The entire staff and doctors were all professional, courteous, and so kind. I'm so happy to have found them and would absolutely recommend them to anyone with a pet. I can't thank them enough!

Immediately puts you on hold and then hangs up on you after 10 minutes. Happened three times over the last 30 minutes.

Their response is a lie, I called them three times over 30 minutes. They never called back or reached back out. Don’t trust them. If they’re willing to lie about something so small imagine what else they’ll lie about to cover their asses.
Staff & Dr Whitford were most helpful in taking care of Clementine. She’s going to be fine and I’ve been reassured. First time visit here. Will become part of the family if vet offices.

I was referred to Tell tail Vet by my regular veterinarian, and from the moment I walked through the door, I knew my 18-year-old dog, Roxy, was in good hands.

I especially want to recognize Marty. As a pet owner facing a stressful situation with a senior dog, I arrived feeling overwhelmed and worried. Marty immediately put me at ease with his calm, compassionate, and reassuring presence. He took the time to listen, answered every question patiently, explained the process thoroughly, and made me feel genuinely heard and supported.

What stood out most was how much he truly connected with both people and their pets. He wasn’t simply checking clients in..he took the time to make each person feel important. Watching him interact with other pet owners and their animals, it was clear that his kindness and care extend to everyone who walks through the door.

By the end of my visit, I felt a tremendous weight lifted off my shoulders. Marty has a rare gift for making people feel comfortable during difficult moments, and his compassion made a lasting impression on me. I am incredibly grateful for the care, patience, and kindness he showed both me and Roxy. I've never had that kind of experience walking into an urgent care.

The entire team I encountered was warm and caring, but Marty truly went above and beyond. Thank you to everyone at Telltail Vet for making a difficult day so much easier.

this clinic is beyond incredible. Dr. Paz, and the whole team working are SO kind and helpful. when i received bad news about my cats ultrasound results- marty i believe his name was (forgive me if im mistaken), was so compassionate and comforting. it was such a safe space. he consoled me and showed so much compassion and genuine care while i was bawling my eyes out. i’m so grateful for the support i received from this clinic🥺 Dr. Paz is so knowledgeable and intelligent. she truly treats her patients like family, and i saw that first hand. all costs are upfront and they explain everything very thoroughly, no hidden fees, or try to upsell you. i loved the transparency which is hard to find these days. i would recommend this clinic 1000% and if you need genuine and adequate care for your pet this is the place to go. thank you guys so much for everything.

We took our cat to Tell Tail for an ultrasound, and it was an outstanding experience. Margo went out of her way to ensure our records were up-to-date, forms were ready to go, and the process was smooth. Everyone who treated our kitty was professional and informative and we left with well-documented information to share with our regular vet.

They accept walk-ins and were able to see us the same day when my dog developed an abscess on her paw that had opened up. During the exam, they found and removed a foxtail that had gotten lodged inside her paw. The front office staff, vet tech, and veterinarian were all friendly and helpful. I was so relieved and grateful that they were able to quickly identify and resolve the issue.

Tell Tail is a sister business to Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic so they share records and notes etc making it a seamless transition to seek urgent care. Also, if it’s the same problem that you dealt with within the previous 12 months at the Pet Clinic then you are charged at the clinic rate and NOT urgent care rate which will save you a little bit of money. That’s a great perk.

Dr Whitford saw my cat today for urinary blockage. She was compassionate, attentive, and spent as long as I needed to answer all my questions. I never felt rushed or pressured into any specific treatment plan. I was very satisfied with my cats care. Great urgent care.
So so happy with the care and customer service we received here. Thank you so much!!

Everyone at this clinic is so professional and friendly. We were seen within a few minutes and they provided excellent care to our cat. Would highly recommend this place. Special thank you to Dr. Whitford who answered all our questions

My four month old puppy either swallowed something or scratched up his throat.  He was coughing, spitting and was just not himself.  I called ahead and asked how long a wait.  She said could be an hour, got there and they took us to a room right away.  They checked him over and they already had all his records from our Vet’s office.  From the receptionist, nurse and doctor everyone was amazing.  The doctor believed he had just irritated his throat and to monitor him.  They only charged me the office call.  I would recommend this place 100%.  I dealt with Animal Hospital a few years back on Jackson in La Mesa, and they literally charge you as you walk thru the doors!   If your Vet can’t fit you in call Tell Tail Vet!

Great place to bring your furry family member in need of urgent care. Our Ellie (Anne) was having breathing issues and the staff here was caring and did diligent work to narrow down the reason. I feel Tell Tail was cost conscious and not looking to nickle and dime us with every exam possible, which was a relief compared to other vets (and the sad norm with human dental and health care). We left their facility confident in the assessment, a few prescriptions, a plan moving forward, and ways to rule out less common potential causes, ultimately narrowing down the issue to asthma. Treatment has been a success and our beloved "alien" (Ellie Anne) is doing a lot better.
They over charge for things there guessing on when it comes to your pets needs & then have you come back 2 weeks later for meds they should have given you in the first place $700 dollars later ..
Outstanding group. Fast, smart, very caring and thorough.  Thanks guys.

Every single staff member here was wonderful. They are all committed to making both pets and owners feel as good as possible about the dire situations that bring someone here.

I cannot thank everyone enough for how caring everyone was.

Everyone was wonderful! Variety of animals with different issues .  We were all treated special and our animals received great care. Atmosphere in waiting room made us feel like friends with each other.

I was out of town and my mom had to use this place as an urgent care for my cat. She told me how kind they were and affordable for an urgent care. They figured out the problem. They were honest with my mom. Euthanasia was decided.  But when they sent me a card in the mail
Telling me how sorry they were for our loss. I was so pleasantly surprised and overjoyed to get his paw prints from an ink paper
And a beautiful inking of his face, something I was out of town. unable to enjoy for the last time. But now I permanently have them on paper, and I appreciate it so much more than words can say. It was the right decision for all. But I am very appreciative of their thoughtfulness and going out of their way to do something really nice. It seems to be a very caring staff.

Amazing place with amazing people!! Dr.Paz is an excellent Dr with extensive knowledge and Marty up front is such a delight and really cares about the fur babies and their owners! My dog needed an abdominal ultrasound recently and he was very anxious so they were able to get him done first and not use any anesthesia and he was in an out within 2 hours. I am so very grateful I found this place!!! I would suggest anyone who is having health issues with their fur baby to come to them, they are truly the best!!

My experience with this Amazing Vet office was absolutely heartwarming! Unfortunately, we had to put our sick girl down and I picked this place based on my intuition. We also had her cremated with rjem Every single person treated us like family and even reached out to us with a touching Momento weeks later. They sent us a card with ink paw prints and her little nose print.

Even without This additional touch, we were floored at how caring and helpful everyone was, especially Marty! He made this touch time bearable and treated us just like family. I will never forget them!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

A shout out to Marty, the CSR, who processes new patients at Tell Tail.  As I was waiting for my own fur baby, I couldn't help but be very impressed with Marty's calm, compassionate care he was giving to another dog (who was clearly in distress) as he questioned its owner on symptoms, etc.  Way to go Marty ... you warmed my heart!

I cannot give this clinic & their staff enough praise. I had to take my pup in twice in the span of 24 hours, both times they were all so incredibly kind & compassionate. They communicated thoroughly & answered all my questions with so much consideration & care. Margo was extremely helpful & made the entire process smooth.  I will tell all my fellow pet parents this is the place to go. From the bottom of my heart thank you to the staff of tail tell vet clinic!!

This will be my second experience with Tell Tail Veterinary and it was another wonderful one. Sadly, my sweet cat Cheeto had become very ill and we knew we had to put him to rest. Upon walking in, we were greeted with exceptional service by Marty! He is honestly the sweetest and just makes you feel at ease during such a stressful time. Margo was super helpful and kind as well! Our wonderful veterinarian was Dr. Whitford and she was absolutely amazing. She listened to all of our concerns and showed so much compassion which meant the world to me as I was devastated. Although, I had to say goodbye to my fur baby, the experience was so much easier with such gentle hands and the empathy and care that all of the staff showed us is unmatched. Thank you so much to all of the staff at Tell Tail from the bottom of my heart. I truly appreciate you.
Vet and receptionist were extremely kind and reassuring for our cat, Maple. Absolutely lovely people who really about your pet and needs. Highly recommend

We brought our 10 year old Westie into the Tell Tail Vet Urgent Care secondary to incessant vomiting and dehydration. As it turned out she had a  blockage of her  small intestine and a large mass in her bladder - that was essentially non-operable. Our family wasn't prepared for this heart breaking news. Given such a grim prognosis we opted to end her suffering.  It was horrible saying goodbye to our 4 legged family member. However the Vet and the  staff were so kind and compassionate.
We will be miss our pup - especially her antics and playful spirit .  But we had a great 10 years with her! Thank you to the staff and Vet at the Tell Tail Veterinary Urgent Care for your kindness. This was a  horrible day that you all made a little more bearable.
From the start very kind and caring for my situation. They made me feel comfortable with what needed to be done. 100% recommend this practice. And there are 3 locations!

Tell Tale Urgent Care  helped me evaluate my sweet, senior dog who had developed a serious tumor.  They were so kind, caring and compassionate .  The vet took extra time to listen and support my decision to say goodbye. 5 days later, I was surprised and touched to receive a handwritten sympathy card by the staff and beautiful nose and paw prints of my 15 year old baby. I do highly recommend this urgent care facility. Kindness is everything.

I’m not one to leave reviews but I had to for this. This was the absolute BEST vet experience I’ve had in the 7 years I’ve had a dog. I had lots of worries but everyone made me feel incredibly comfortable and took great care of my dog. Big shoutout to Marty who was at the front desk. He is the absolute best. Incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, helpful and makes you feel comfortable.

They helped my baby a lot. My wife and I were there most of the day. They worked fast and were really friendly.  Best dog lover staff! However my pics are merely to troll and have fun. They called my girl thicc 8/10 and made her look like she had a wrap sheet and was wanted. (I cropped parts of the report for this entertainment)

I hate that I had to learn about Tell Tail, but I am so glad I did. A very sudden health emergency with my beloved dog led me to this urgent care facility seeking diagnostics. The news was not good and we ended up having to say goodbye that day. Dr. Halsey and Marty could not have been more kind, compassionate, or understanding throughout the entire process. Losing a pet is one of the worst things anyone can go through, but we feel our boy's journey over the rainbow bridge could not have been handled any better. I hope anyone who has to bid their furry family member goodbye can have a process as seamless and considerate as this.

The most positive veterinary experience I have ever had! One of my cats needed an ultrasound and Marty got her in right away.  Dr. Paz reviewed the results with me and took extra time giving me her thoughts as well as some articles about the condition. The price for all of the services I received was also quite reasonable.  The Tell Tail team made this very stressful situation so much easier on me and my cat! Thank you 😊.

We brought our dog in to look at an injured paw and received excellent care at Tell Tail. Everyone we interacted with was warm and compassionate. Dr. Whitford was extremely thorough and knowledgeable and I felt very comfortable with her exam, explanation, and plan. The clinic was kind enough to check in on us the next day and I was happy to be able to report that thanks to them, our dog was in much less pain. I’m very grateful for the level of care we received and would strongly recommend Tell Tail for same day veterinary care.
Marty, Angel, Jessica, all the vets and staff are truly top notch! Walker and Rowdy were totally comfortable with everyone. The service is outstanding!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This is a walk-in only urgent care only open during the day.

I came in for my puppy who had a UTI on a Wednesday morning and the whole process took about ~2 hours. The wait was long, but a UTI is considered less threatening so some other pets were prioritized which is understandable. Dr Whitford is kind and was amazing at explaining everything. They also follow up by email which is nice.

To save your coins, be prepared to say “no” to tests/treatments that you don’t think your pet needs. All itemized care options are optional- so do what you think is best for your circumstance!

I was frantically calling around 7-8 different emergency pet hospitals and Tell Tail Veterinary was able to take my 11 year old Bulldog within the hour. I appreciate their kindness and patience towards both me and my dog as I was trying to keep calm under this difficult time. I will keep them in my arsenal when I have another emergency. The staff has been tremendously supportive and helpful.  THANK YOU to the team. I am so glad they are here for us.
The staff was one of the kindest, helpful, friendly, professional I've ever been to. Each and every person including doctor were thorough. I felt good about coming here. The service is amazing.

I just took my dog to a different emergency vet and it reminded me how bad tell tail was. Lacking compassion and very high pressure about doing every possible test up front for thousands of dollars. I had to really grill them to get them to admit we could start with the first couple most likely things then get the results before spending thousands more if needed. A real money grab - avoid.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I was referred by my vet to come here after calling and telling them about my baby’s incident. I really appreciate the friendly kindness and helpful services that me and my chow chow Chloe had received today. I highly recommend. Thank you to Dr. Soares and her team for taking the time to exam my fur baby.

Everyone in the office from the
Moment I called, to the staff at the front desk and the vet were kind, compassionate and helpful . My dog Charley couldn’t get into his regular vet in a timely manner and they recommended Tell Tail. We could not have more pleased .

This place helps your pet when they need urgent care but it isn’t quite ER worthy. With a senior dog, we find that vet visits are more common. We were recommended here by our vet to assist with an urgent pain in eye for our dog. The staff was wonderful and even tolerated my anxiety as I was very worried about my best friend. True compassion. Thank you.

Was recommended to tell tail from my vet as they were unable to see us today. I called in and spoke to Marty(who was wonderful) I was very frazzled and he reassured me. Ula ended up needing surgery which was very scary but everyone that I was in contact with was great, they are friendly and compassionate. Thank you Dr. Brida, Tayler and everyone else at tell tail for taking care of my baby. Also thank god for care credit!

Closes6pm! They SAY it's urgent care after hours filling in the Gap from general practice and emergency. Hours. FALSE.Shady. Horrible customer service desk got hung up on the first time second time got told to find a localER then HUNG UP ON ME  as I was speaking again called back no answer!! Rude, name was MARTY.false ad, and glad I am not taking my pet here
Thank you for a wonderful experience.  We were treated like family from the time we arrived until evening we done. Customer Service was Exemplary. Definitely worth the recommendation.

The staff and whole team at tell tail veterinarian urgent care are so helpful and very concerned and knowledgeable they are angels they not only care about your  pet but you also they make you feel assured that your pet and you are in the best care that you could ever be in I recommend them to everybody
Grateful to have this great urgent care vet in my neighborhood.

Thankful I found this urgent care. I was referred by my vet to take my senior dog in for an urgent ultrasound. The staff and provider were amazing- warm, patient, kind, and informative. This is much appreciated as a pet owner stressing over their fur baby’s health. Marty was especially helpful-he explained pre and post procedure care clearly. I trusted all the staff at Tell Tale to take good care of my pup.
Highly recommend Tell Tail for anyone seeking urgent care for their furry family member(s).

I am a first time dog mom and my pup is my entire life. From the second I called to talk to them, Marty (I think?) was so kind and reassuring. He made me feel so much better and so comfortable. His compassionate and empathetic attitude really blew me away, I was just amazed by this place. My sweet Marmalade was brought in and taken care of swiftly and when I talked to the vet after, she was so soft and thorough. I loved these people and I will tell anyone who ever needs an emergency vet to go here because it really eases the nerves when you have such an understanding and kind staff. Thank you guys so much, from the bottom of my heart. 💖
